panel.name: workspace_editor
panel.text: Save viewport, bars, Inventory, maps, compatible chat geometry, and the Received Items panel size. Preferences and the workspace switcher are excluded.

combo_box.name: workspace_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Workspaces are stored separately for each account.

check_box.name: workspace_remember_folders
check_box.label: Remember Inventory folders
check_box.tool_tip: For this save: restore single-folder roots and view modes, or a selected folder and expanded branches in All Items (up to 256). Search filters and item selections are not saved.

check_box.name: workspace_capture_inventory
check_box.label: Restore Inventory windows and Received Items

check_box.name: workspace_capture_toolbars
check_box.label: Restore toolbar buttons and display mode

button.label: Add workspace inventory window
button.name: workspace_add_inventory
button.tool_tip: Open one extra inventory window managed by workspaces. All open additional Inventory windows are also saved.

panel.text: Tabbed Conversations saves size and position only. Inventory folders are optional; search filters, item selections and inventory contents are never saved.
